title: Kindly Chickpea Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful Mediterranean-inspired pilaf with chickpeas, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is easy to make and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Mince the garlic and add it to the saucepan, cooking for another minute.
Add the dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the rice to the saucepan and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chickpeas, vegetable broth, and chopped parsley to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
